memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: routine follow‑up of COPD, hypothyroidism and vitamin D deficiency.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports occasional breathlessness on exertion, stable weight, no new symptoms.
EXAMINATION: BP 138/84 mmHg, weight 62 kg, BMI 23.4 (overweight). SpO2 94% on room air. Chest clear, no wheeze. Thyroid not enlarged.
IMPRESSION: COPD stable on current inhalers. Hypothyroidism euthyroid on levothyroxine 50 mcg OD. Vitamin D deficiency – level low, will replace.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue tiotropium OD, salbutamol SOS, budesonide‑formoterol BD. Start levothyroxine 50 mcg OD (already). Start cholecalciferol 60000 IU once weekly for 8 weeks then 1000 IU OD. Advise weight reduction, daily walk 30 min. Return if increased breathlessness, fever >39°C, chest pain, or hemoptysis.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Tiotropium inhaler 18 mcg OD
Salbutamol inhaler 100 mcg SOS
Budesonide‑formoterol 200/6 inhaler 2 puffs BD
Levothyroxine 50 mcg tablet OD
Cholecalciferol 60000 IU capsule once weekly for 8 weeks

memories.author: lab
memories.text:

Free T4 12.5 pmol/L (12‑22) – normal
Serum 25‑hydroxyvitamin D 14 ng/mL (<30 deficient)
Serum calcium 9.1 mg/dL (8.5‑10.5)

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Spirometry: FEV1 1.68 L (55% predicted), FVC 2.90 L (88% predicted), FEV1/FVC 0.58 (below 0.70) – consistent with moderate obstructive defect.

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Chest X‑ray PA: lungs show hyperinflated fields, flattened diaphragms, no focal consolidation, no pleural effusion. Cardiac size within normal limits.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: review of symptoms and medication tolerance.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient notes mild increase in wheezing after housework, otherwise well.
EXAMINATION: BP 140/86 mmHg, weight 61.5 kg, BMI 23.0 (overweight). SpO2 93% on room air. Mild expiratory wheeze bilaterally.
IMPRESSION: COPD slight worsening; consider stepping up bronchodilator. Hypothyroidism: TSH slightly elevated, need dose increase. Vitamin D repletion ongoing.
ARRANGEMENTS: Increase levothyroxine to 75 mcg OD. Add salbutamol inhaler 2 puffs QID PRN for wheeze. Continue other COPD meds. Advise avoid triggers, use inhaler before exertion. Return if worsening dyspnea, night symptoms, fever >39°C, or swelling of legs.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: autumn review and influenza vaccination.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports stable breathing, no exacerbations since last visit.
EXAMINATION: BP 138/82 mmHg, weight 61 kg, BMI 22.9 (overweight). SpO2 94% on room air. Chest clear with mild wheeze only on forced expiration.
IMPRESSION: COPD stable. Hypothyroidism subclinical, levothyroxine 75 mcg OD adequate. Vitamin D repletion complete.
ARRANGEMENTS: Give influenza vaccine (inactivated) today 2025‑10‑20. Continue current meds. Advise annual flu vaccine, pneumococcal vaccine if not given. Return if new cough with fever, worsening dyspnea, chest pain, or hemoptysis.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: winter check‑up, medication review.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient feels well, no respiratory symptoms, denies cold intolerance.
EXAMINATION: BP 136/80 mmHg, weight 60.8 kg, BMI 22.8 (overweight). SpO2 95% on room air. Chest clear.
IMPRESSION: COPD stable. Hypothyroidism: TSH still slightly high, consider further levothyroxine increase. Vitamin D levels adequate.
ARRANGEMENTS: Increase levothyroxine to 100 mcg OD. Continue tiotropium, salbutamol SOS, budesonide‑formoterol BD. Advise maintain activity, avoid smoke. Return if worsening dyspnea, fever >39°C, palpitations, or unexplained weight change.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: annual metabolic review and vaccine update.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports no new symptoms, tolerates meds well.
EXAMINATION: BP 134/78 mmHg, weight 60.5 kg, BMI 22.7 (overweight). SpO2 95% on room air.
IMPRESSION: COPD stable. Hypothyroidism euthyroid on levothyroxine 100 mcg OD. Vitamin D borderline; will supplement.
ARRANGEMENTS: Order fasting lipid profile and fasting blood sugar (already done). Continue current meds. Start cholecalciferol 1000 IU OD for maintenance. Advise diet rich in calcium, weight‑bearing exercise. Return if chest pain, dyspnea at rest, fever >39°C, or melena.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: autumn review, influenza vaccination, COPD assessment.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports occasional mild wheeze on climbing stairs, otherwise well.
EXAMINATION: BP 136/82 mmHg, weight 60.2 kg, BMI 22.6 (overweight). SpO2 94% on room air. Mild expiratory wheeze.
IMPRESSION: COPD stable, no exacerbation. Hypothyroidism euthyroid. Vitamin D maintained.
ARRANGEMENTS: Give influenza vaccine (inactivated) today 2026‑10‑08. Continue tiotropium OD, salbutamol SOS, budesonide‑formoterol BD, levothyroxine 100 mcg OD, cholecalciferol 1000 IU OD. Advise smoking avoidance (non‑smoker), annual flu vaccine. Return if increased wheeze, fever >39°C, chest pain, hemoptysis, or sudden swelling of legs.
